thought: Ma Baoyu is the squad leader and protagonist - the commander of the six-man unit. He needs to be immediately recognizable as THE leader among the five soldiers. Comparing with others: Ge Zhenlin (vice leader) is described as 'sturdy with strong jawline,' Song Xueyi has a 'simple/honest face,' the Hu brothers are cheerful, and the Political Instructor has 'sharp facial features.' Ma Baoyu needs a distinctive visual marker that screams 'field commander' without being too high-ranking. The most effective distinctive features would be: 1) His physical build - tall and lean (contrasting with Ge's sturdy build), 2) Equipment that marks leadership - binoculars around his neck (practical for a squad leader who scouts and directs), 3) A defining facial feature - thick, dark eyebrows giving him a naturally commanding look. The binoculars are the key distinctive prop that sets him apart immediately.
distinctive_features: Tall, lean build with a pair of binoculars hanging from his neck, thick dark eyebrows, weathered sun-tanned face
prompt: Full body portrait of a tall, lean Eighth Route Army squad leader standing at attention in a commanding upright stance. The man has a weathered, sun-tanned face with distinctively thick, dark eyebrows that give him a natural look of authority. Most prominently, a pair of military binoculars hangs from a strap around his neck, marking his role as field commander. He wears a blue-gray Eighth Route Army uniform jacket, standard military cap with red star emblem, brown leather belt with ammunition pouches, dark cotton pants, and cloth shoes. A rifle is slung across his back. Centered composition, symmetrical framing, eye-level angle. The subject stands against a single colored dark burnt sienna background with high contrast separation, creating a bold silhouette. Dramatic chiaroscuro lighting from the front-left, creating strong shadows that emphasize his lean facial structure and the binoculars at his chest. Cool to neutral color temperature with low-saturation earth tones - muted slate blues, weathered grays, dusty browns. The metal and glass of the binoculars catch a subtle highlight. Solemn, heroic, and resolute atmosphere reflecting the gravity of 1941 wartime China. Realistic, thick-painted 2D animation style with bold, visible brushstrokes and strong contrast between illuminated and shadowed areas, emphasizing the harsh, dignified, and epic nature of historical events. Deep focus keeping the entire figure sharp from head to toe. Non-distorted portrait lens with natural perspective. The overall mood conveys unwavering leadership, tactical awareness, and quiet determination. Cultural portraiture, historically accurate 1941 Chinese Eighth Route Army uniform and equipment, realistic rendering with painterly texture.
ref_description: Tall, lean soldier with binoculars around his neck and thick dark eyebrows
